title: I built a Notion OS with Claude
hook: I've made a Notion OS, an operating system connected to my personal life, my content creation life and my career.
summary: Notion + Claude: the operating system that runs my content, career and life.
body: Notion + Claude: the operating system that runs my content, career and life.

Every video idea I post lands in one Notion dashboard. Claude writes the script, plans the shots and camera angles, and tracks what other creators in my niche are doing. It also runs my personal stuff, like a travel itinerary I can send to people as a Notion page.
Comment NOTION and I'll show you what this OS looks like inside.
guide: Build a Notion workspace that Claude fills in for you: one place for content ideas, money, goals and travel. You need a Notion account and Claude (the Claude app or Claude Code) connected to Notion.
1. Decide what the hub should hold, for example content ideas, a monthly savings target, a quarterly goal, app bugs and features, and a travel plan.
1. Connect Claude to your Notion workspace using Notion's connector, and share with it only the pages you want it to touch.
1. Describe your life to Claude in plain English and ask it to create one Notion database per area, plus a single hub page that links to them all.
1. Add a content-ideas database where each idea gets a hook, a script, suggested shots and camera angles, and a list of what other creators in your niche are posting.
1. Add a money database with one row per month and a tick or cross for whether you hit your savings target, and an apps database with bugs and features grouped by project.
1. Build a travel itinerary as its own Notion page listing where you will be and when, then use Notion's Share option to send it to people.
1. Open the hub on your phone, tap through each area, and ask Claude to fix anything that is missing or in the wrong place.
Watch out: let Claude build the structure rather than dragging blocks by hand, and only share the travel page, never the hub, since the hub holds your money and goals.

```
You are helping me build a personal operating system in Notion. I have a Notion account and you are connected to my workspace through Notion's connector. Create one hub page called <hub name> that links to separate databases for: content ideas, money, goals, apps and travel. For content ideas, give each row properties for hook, script, shots and camera angles, platform and status, plus a place for notes on what other creators in <my niche> are posting. For money, create one row per month with a checkbox for whether I hit my savings target of <amount>. For goals, track one quarterly goal, <my goal>, and this week's experiment. For apps, track bugs and features grouped by project: <my projects>. For travel, create a shareable itinerary page for <trip>, with dates, areas and locations. Use sensible property types, add two example rows to each database, and keep the hub readable on a phone. Do not share anything publicly. When finished, list what you created and anything you were unable to do.
```
